The Cold Snap event revolves around the Flickering Flames project, which has five levels of tasks to complete. Every level requires you to commit certain items, and that's where you're going to need the Frying Pan.

entry.title: What is the ‘Embark Game Boot’ Error in ARC Raiders?
entry.summary:
ARC Raiders, being a competitive multiplayer online game, is prone to all sorts of glitches, bugs, and issues that prevent players from logging in.
One such problem is the so-called Embark Game Boot error, which players have sporadically been receiving over the past couple of months. Thankfully, it seems easy to fix, so here's everything you need to know.
Embark Game Boot error in ARC Raiders, explained
ARC Raiders faces many issues as an online competitive game. Image via Embark
The Embark Game Boot error seems to appear when the game's anti-cheat system, Easy Anti-Cheat (EAC), malfunctions. It does not really give you the necessary information as to why the issue is happening, and it can be quite confusing when you try to troubleshoot it.
However, the best two ways of resolving this issue are the following.
First, verify the integrity of your game files. After that's done, head on over to your start menu, type in “run” and open the app. In it, type “MSConfig.exe” and hit enter. Once in there, head to the “Services” tab and disable Easy Anti-Cheat to ensure it does not launch with your PC. Reboot your machine, then navigate to C:\Program Files (x86)\EasyAntiCheat_EOS and delete “EasyAntiCheat_EOS.sys.”
Reboot the machine again and start ARC Raiders, and the game should run smoothly and without issue.
If the problem persists, however, your next best bet is to completely uninstall and remove Easy Anti-Cheat, uninstall ARC Raiders, and then re-download the entire game. Make sure to reboot your system after deleting both completely prior to the reinstallation. Running ARC Raiders once the game is downloaded should also re-download the entire Easy Anti-Cheat suite, allowing the software to start fresh.
If you still face issues, your best bet is to contact ARC Raiders support, while making sure you are not running any third-party software or hardware that could be conflicting with EAC.

entry.title: You better binge the Fallout TV show because the next game is making its story canon, according to Todd Howard
entry.summary:
The Fallout TV show's second season has finished and is getting favorable reviews from the audience and critics alike. It continues where the first season left off, building on the characters, the world, and the story. And all of that could be part of Fallout 5, or so says Todd Howard.
Fallout 5 remains a figment of imagination, with the game probably up to a decade away. The Elder Scrolls 6, announced in 2018, is likely Bethesda's current and main focus, though even that is probably some five years off by all accounts. Even so, Howard was keen on commenting about what that game could potentially entail, at least in relation to the currently-airing Fallout TV show.
Walton Goggins is officially canon. Image via Amazon
Asked by the BBC whether the TV show will have an “impact” on this potential next installment in the long-running franchise, Howard said Bethesda is “taking [the show] into account.”
“Fallout 5 will be existing in a world where the stories and events of the show happened or are happening,” Howard explained. This would make the TV show fully canon to the games, making the seasons fundamentally important for anyone who wishes to experience Fallout 5.
Of course, you could argue that the game will most likely take place in a separate location and time period, but that nevertheless does not dispute the seasons as crucial parts of the overarching lore of the Fallout universe.
I myself have not yet seen any bit of the Fallout TV show, but with how much praise it's getting, I might just do it. Now, with Howard's extra bit of context, I'm inclined to reconsider my stance on the show, despite my many criticisms aimed at the epidemic of video game adaptations.

Where to find Water Filter in ARC Raiders
These are the zones I've had the most luck with when looking for Water Filters. Screenshot and remix by Destructoid
Water Filter usually spawns in Industrial loot zones that can be found on just about every map of the game. However, I've had a lot of luck with them on Dam Battlegrounds, specifically in the Research and Administration building (itself quite a good spot for valuable loot overall). Try to loot every single container you come across in the building, and odds are you will get at least one Water Filter, if not more.
Additionally, Water Filters tend to spawn in Security Breach boxes. These can only be opened if you have the necessary skill unlocked from the Survival tree, but trust me, they're worth it. Security Breaches are scattered across all the maps, but you can find one in the Power Generation Complex on Dam Battlegrounds, which you can visit and loot before gunning for the RnD building.

entry.title: How to get the V1 armor in Palworld
entry.summary:
The V1 armor is now available in Palworld after the launch of the Home Sweet Home update, and you can construct it with the correct resources.
This is the second major video game collaboration that Palworld has had this year. The ULTRAKILL collab adds several iconic weapons and armors for you to find, and the V1 armor appears to be unique.
Table of contents How to craft V1 armor in Palword Palworld V1 armor stats and effects
How to craft V1 armor in Palword
The V1 armor appears to be present in two variants: Normal and Legendary. You can craft the Normal variant after unlocking the gear piece from the Research tab.
Here's the list of items that you'll require.
15 High Quality Pal Oil (can be obtained by eliminating high-level Pals. The item is relatively rare)
30 Ingots (can be produced at your base. You'll require raw metals to find the item)
You'll require a player level of at least 32 to be able to craft this armor. To do so, first unlock the V1 armor blueprint from the Technology tab. Then, you'll need the resources in the required quantities as mentioned above.
Screenshot by Destructoid
You can craft the V1 armor at any of the following workbenches.
Production Assembly Line
Production Assembly Line II
Advanced Civilization Workshop
You can also purchase the Legendary V1 armor from the Medal Merchant in exchange for 780 Dog Coins. It's also apparently available in the Arena store.
Palworld V1 armor stats and effects
The V1 Armor is modeled after the Final War machine and offers a self-repair system that will activate whenever you deal damage. Here are its base stats in Palworld.
Defense 51
HP 806
Cold Resistannt Lv. 1

entry.title: AMD's FSR Redstone upgrades are a match for DLSS, even if they slay a sacred cow to do it
entry.summary: Today, AMD are prodding the launch button for FSR Redstone: a suite of upscaling, frame generation, and ray tracing upgrades that, just maybe, might stop Nvidia DLSS 4's campaign of strutting across the canteen and slapping FSR’s lunch tray over in front of all the other graphics card technologies. To achieve this, FSR has become the monster it fights. Gone are the technologically simplified, GPU-agnostic measures employed by previous FSR versions; Redstone deals exclusively in more sophisticated machine-learning tools that specifically require the latest Radeon graphics hardware to function.
